title: Optional AWS media backend adapter crate
description: New optional crate (not a protocol crate) implementing the VtcBackend media hooks on AWS: MediaLive channel per livestream (never per call), MediaPackage (LL-HLS/DASH, optional SPEKE), MediaConnect/SRT input, CloudFront signed URLs for playback credentials, recording harvest to S3 then MediaConvert into the VTCRecording blob. Map channel states IDLE/STARTING/RUNNING/STOPPING onto starting/live/stopped; idle auto-stop. Tests: contract-level mocks in CI plus a small manual paid integration suite. License/SPDX copied from siblings.
